newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Caldera shuffles cabinet, adds new post.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Caldera shuffles cabinet, adds new post.

text.p: Venezuelan President Rafael Caldera shuffled his cabinet on Thursday, removing the ministers of justice, health and urban development and creating a new post to oversee reform of the social security system.
The changes took to five the number of cabinet ministers to lose their jobs this year following the removal in February of the labour and environment ministers.
Information Minister Fernando Egana told reporters Hilarion Cardozo would replace Henrique Meier as justice minister.

Cardozo is a leading member of Social Christian party Copei which Caldera helped form in 1945. Meier, who oversaw the demolition on Sunday of the country's most violent prison, Catia, will head a commission to push through reform of the judicial system, Egana said.
At the Health Ministry, Jose Felix Oleta, director of the Vargas Hospital in Caracas, replaces Pedro Rincon Gutierrez who said Wednesday he was resigning because of illness.
The urban development post is to be taken on by Julio Marti, director of the national Housing Institute (INAVI), who replaces Francisco Gonzalez.
Caldera also created a new post -- "Minister of State for the Reform of the Social Security System" -- and nominated Jose Miguel Uzcategui, congressional leader of the government party Convergence.
The ministers will be sworn in Friday, Egana said.
